mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake, which can reduce renal potassium excretion and increase serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment or those on concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly, particularly in patients with renal disease, diabetes, or concurrent use of ACE inhibitors, ARBs, or NSAIDs; assess need for potassium supplementation.
